heroHeadline: Tbilisi Protests Pass 620 Days as Crackdown Deepens
heroSubtitle: Daily demonstrations against Georgian Dream continue as Amnesty International documents the criminalisation of dissent, Transparency International Georgia tracks 91 political prisoners, EU accession remains frozen to 2028, and the ruling party seeks a Constitutional Court ban on the three largest opposition parties.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
